race.comment: VERY GOOD (6) goes well for hoop Morrison who has three wins and two placings from eight steers and strikes a very winnable contest here. Only needs some luck navigating from the sticky draw to be playing a major role in the outcome. BELLZEN (1) has won over this track and trip and gets a stack of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Looms as the main danger. TIPPED OFF (5) has a win and a second from four attempts over this course and distance and is more than capable enough on his day. Top-three aspirations. NORDIC INVADER (7) strips fitter third-up from the spell and maps ideally for this from gate two. In the mix on best figures. EXOLENT CHOICE (2) saves his best form for this sprint journey and should give backers a sight.
